'''Der' behag''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] employed as a banker in [[Kaas City]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />
